title: Answer
description:
The day truly cleansed for that day, and God still did not desire those offerings as the final thing. Both stand because a cleansing for a day is not a taking away.

The opened ear is lifelong obedience. The prepared body is what the letter's argument offers. The first thing taken away is the arrangement of those offerings, not obedience. Sanctifying is the blood put on the body, done once, so that it is not repeated every morning.
